scientific_integrity: Ground-state completeness is established by an exact reduction and constrained minimization proof; randomized finite-dimensional searches are corroborative only. Full primary text examined for nearby 2010, 2019 studies, but an older 1986 related paper was limited to an abstract.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for finite classical XY complete graphs with strictly positive independently weighted matched antiferromagnetic edges, otherwise unit ferromagnetic interactions, at zero temperature. The theorem does not assert finite-temperature phase behavior, dynamics, or quantum-spin claims. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: A reciprocal-coupling ground-state transition in frustrated complete-graph XY dimers
